SSL::session
       Drops a session from the SSL session cache.

SYNOPSIS
       SSL::session invalidate ( drop | nodrop )?

DESCRIPTION
       Invalidates the current session. If no parameter is specified, or the "drop" parameter is specified, this commands drops
       the current SSL session ID from the session cache to prevent reuse of the session. If "nodrop" is specified, the current
       session will be invalidated but the session will not be dropped from the session cache.

RETURN VALUE
       SSL::session invalidate
	   Invalidates the current session. Specifically, this command drops the current SSL session ID from the session cache to
       prevent reuse of the session.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	    if { [HTTP::uri] contains "/maint_mode" } {
		## send content and die
		HTTP::respond 200 content $::error_html Connection Close
		event HTTP_REQUEST disable
		SSL::session invalidate
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.2.0 --First introduced the command.
